from collections import Counter

# Compute most common genre for each playlist
playlist_genres = {}
for pl in playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    # most_common returns list of (genre, count) sorted by count desc, then insertion order
